description: Subtitles 16:9 (brand style "brand-16x9"): Neuborn 4 % H, centred at the bottom (last line at 88 % H), at most 2 lines of 48 characters, hard shadow. Reads captions.json. Alpha overlay for the whole timeline; startFrame allows chapter files for long episodes.

parameters.startFrame: Timeline frame shown by output frame 0 (default 0)
